settings.brandTagline: Travel with Comfort. Travel with Us!
settings.corePromise: Arrive with confidence. Travel in comfort.

categories.name: Premium SUVs
categories.description: Spacious, high-clearance 4x4s and crossovers suitable for Kigali travel, VIP events, and scenic upcountry roads.

categories.name: Electric & Hybrid
categories.description: Next-generation electric, range-extended, and plug-in hybrid SUVs combining whisper-quiet refinement with range.

categories.name: Executive Cars
categories.description: Comfortable, refined sedans tailored for business meetings, airport arrivals, and city navigation.

categories.name: Vans & Buses
categories.description: High-roof passenger vans and 28-seater Toyota Coaster minibuses for delegations and family groups.

categories.name: Wedding & VIP
categories.description: Flagship executive SUVs, sedans, and coordinated Coaster shuttles for Rwandan weddings, Gusaba, and summits.

services.name: Car Rental
services.shortSummary: Flexible daily and multi-day vehicle rental in Kigali and across Rwanda.
services.fullDescription: Reliable vehicle rental for personal, family, or business travel in Rwanda. Clear agreements, verified maintenance, and dedicated local support throughout your journey.

services.name: Airport Transfers
services.shortSummary: Punctual Kigali International Airport (KGL) arrivals and departures.
services.fullDescription: Arrive in Rwanda with peace of mind. We track your flight, assist with luggage, and ensure direct, comfortable transfer to your residence, hotel, or meeting in Kigali or upcountry.

services.name: Weddings & Ceremonies
services.shortSummary: Distinguished bridal convoys and guest transport for life’s important celebrations.
services.fullDescription: Coordinated transport for traditional Gusaba, civil weddings, and receptions. Combine VIP bridal vehicles (V8, TXL, K5) with spacious coaster buses for family and wedding guests.

services.name: Vans, Coasters & Group Transport
services.shortSummary: Coordinated transport for delegations, diaspora family reunions, and organisations.
services.fullDescription: Passenger vans (HiAce class, Starex) and Toyota Coaster minibuses equipped to transport groups, large luggage volumes, and organizational delegations across Rwanda.

services.name: Corporate & Event Transport
services.shortSummary: Professional ground logistics for conferences, NGOs, and visiting executives.
services.fullDescription: Ground transport logistics for Kigali summits, NGO missions, and corporate events. Professional protocol, punctual scheduling, and dedicated coordinator support.

services.name: Self-Drive Rental
services.shortSummary: Unpublished — requires owner confirmation of insurance terms and driver requirements.
services.fullDescription: Self-drive rental option. Kept unpublished until insurance policies, security deposits, and age requirements are verified by the business owner.

services.name: Dedicated Chauffeur Service
services.shortSummary: Unpublished — requires owner confirmation of driver pricing rules.
services.fullDescription: Professional dedicated driver service for daily hire. Kept unpublished until driver daily allowances and working hours are verified.

services.name: Scenic Regional Transport
services.shortSummary: Unpublished — Travel Rwanda does not offer invented tour packages.
services.fullDescription: Transport to regional destinations like Lake Kivu, Musanze, or Akagera. Kept unpublished until specific itineraries are confirmed by the owner.

vehicles.name: Toyota Land Cruiser Prado TXL
vehicles.subtitle: Gloss black executive 4x4 tailored for Kigali VIP travel, weddings & provincial routes
vehicles.description: Presented in gloss black showroom condition, the Land Cruiser Prado TXL pairs a distinctive vertical chrome grille, dual-zone climate comfort, three-row leather seating, and dependable full-time 4WD. A signature favourite for weddings, diplomats, and upcountry Rwanda journeys.
excludedItems: Chauffeur accommodation on multi-day upcountry stays if selected

vehicles.name: Toyota Land Cruiser Prado 4x4 Expedition
vehicles.subtitle: Steel-bumper 4x4 expedition Land Cruiser built for national parks and steep terrain
vehicles.description: Specially outfitted with a heavy-duty ARB-style steel front protection bumper, integrated fog lights, roof rails, and rugged mud-terrain tires. Engineered to tackle Akagera tracks, Nyungwe Forest hills, and Volcanoes National Park roads with complete confidence.

vehicles.name: Yangwang U8 Luxury 4x4
vehicles.subtitle: Ultra-luxury flagship range-extended electric 4x4 in Dragonstone Teal for VIP & bridal arrivals
vehicles.description: BYD's flagship ultra-luxury SUV delivers effortless silent torque via the e4 quad-motor independent wheel-drive system and DiSus-P intelligent hydraulic body control suspension. Pair signature Time-Space Portal LED prestige with 1,000 km combined EREV range for high-profile summits and VIP ceremonies.
includedItems: Whisper-quiet cabin with executive climate control
excludedItems: Fuel / Charging for extended regional range

vehicles.name: BYD Seal U Executive SUV
vehicles.subtitle: Quiet, spacious silver metallic Ocean-Series crossover built for Kigali comfort
vehicles.description: Clean modern aerodynamics paired with BYD Blade Battery refinement. Inside, passengers enjoy a flat rear cabin floor for generous legroom, vegan leather comfort, panoramic sunroof, and a practical 425L–1,440L cargo bay for airport suitcases and daily Kigali travel.

vehicles.name: Kia K5 Executive Sedan
vehicles.subtitle: Sleek black 2025 fastback sedan with Star-Map LED styling for business & KGL transfers
vehicles.description: Sharp architectural proportions, signature Star-Map LED daytime lighting, acoustic cabin insulation, and a generous 15.6 cu. ft. trunk make the 2025 Kia K5 the premier choice for executives, solo travellers, couples, and bridal escort duties across Kigali.

vehicles.name: Kia Sorento 2025 Executive
vehicles.subtitle: Updated slate-blue three-row executive SUV featuring Star-Map lighting & black alloy wheels
vehicles.description: Refreshed with bold vertical quad-LED headlights, amber T-bar daytime signatures, black alloy wheels, and a versatile three-row cabin with up to 2,085L expandable storage when rear seats fold. Built for visiting executives, weddings, and family comfort.

vehicles.name: Kia Sorento 7-Seater SUV
vehicles.subtitle: Pacific Blue three-row crossover balancing highway comfort with flexible family space
vehicles.description: Finished in Pacific Blue with signature tiger-nose grille detailing, the Kia Sorento seats up to 7 passengers smoothly with multi-zone cabin cooling and adaptable luggage space for diaspora families and small groups visiting Rwanda.
suitableUses: Kigali to Lake Kivu highway comfort

vehicles.name: Hyundai Tucson Next-Gen
vehicles.subtitle: Architectural metallic-bronze crossover featuring full-width H-Edge LED lighting
vehicles.description: Showcasing Hyundai's sculpted Art of Steel design language with a wider stance, clamshell hood, indirect full-width horizontal LED bar, and expanded rear legroom and cargo volume for refined daily commuting and regional highway trips.

vehicles.name: Hyundai Tucson Plug-in Hybrid
vehicles.subtitle: Dark navy HTRAC AWD plug-in hybrid SUV combining quiet efficiency with confident grip
vehicles.description: Equipped with Hyundai HTRAC all-wheel drive and plug-in hybrid efficiency, the dark navy Tucson delivers smooth urban electric cruising, agile handling through Kigali's hills, parametric taillight styling, and generous suitcase capacity.

vehicles.name: Toyota HiAce Passenger Van
vehicles.subtitle: Silver H200 high-roof 14-seater commuter van engineered for group delegations
vehicles.description: Trusted across Rwanda and East Africa for unmatched stamina and spacious headroom. Features wide sliding door access, privacy-tinted panoramic windows, seating for 14 passengers, and dependable diesel endurance for delegations and family groups.
excludedItems: Driver overnight allowance on multi-day upcountry trips

vehicles.name: Toyota Coaster Bus
vehicles.subtitle: Air-conditioned 28–30 seater executive minibus fleet for weddings, conferences & delegations
vehicles.description: Deployed individually or in matched multi-bus convoys, our white Toyota Coaster fleet offers overhead air conditioning, comfortable high-back seats, panoramic views, and spacious luggage storage for Kigali conferences, Gusaba guests, and large delegations.
excludedItems: Multi-day driver overnight stipend outside Kigali
